projectSummary: Supports the statement that the clavicular portion of the pectoralis major is substantially activated during a dumbbell fly, which is the nearest activation evidence in this pass to the index cable fly.

publication.statusSource: PubMed record comments-and-corrections fields plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; the report gives no numeric activation values in the retrievable text; two-channel instrumentation.

study.intervention: frontal-lateral cross with dumbbells, four modalities
study.population: Electromyographic activity of the anterior deltoid and the clavicular portion of the pectoralis major was tested in 24 male volunteers during four different modalities of the frontal-lateral cross with dumbbells. All tested exercises developed high levels of action potential for both muscles.

title: Electromyographic validation of basic exercises for physical conditioning programmes. IV. Analysis of the deltoid muscle (anterior portion) and pectoralis major muscle (clavicular portion) in frontal-lateral cross, dumbbells exercises.
